notes.title: Mini Zombie Bash
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/349398a8de9bc6e10a8df7a9aa0acc9a96fa74ea.jpg[/img]
[h1]Mini Zombies have arrived and it’s time to PARTY !!![/h1]

These party guests have gotten out of control, I guess it’s either time to join them or fight them. Share a screenshot of you playing the new Zombie Within Gate Mode!

In this mode Defenders now have to fight off mini zombies whenever a Zombie Imposter breaks a generator. These bite-sized enemies will actively chase the nearby Defender, but to give them a leg up, Defenders will have various powers ups scattered throughout the map. They can also find power ups in chests and drops after slaying some mini zombies. Use [b]#GateMode[/b] in your submission to qualify. 

Our favorite screenshot will win 3 Zombie Within Keys for their friends!

[h3]Submission Rules:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Submit a screenshot to the Zombie Within Steam Forum of you playing the new Gate Mode
[*] Must include the following tag in submission to be considered [b]#GateMode[/b]
[*] One entry per user 
[*] Once winners are announced they have 30 days to respond to the ww_cm account to receive their keys
[/list]
[h3]Submission Details: [/h3]
[list]
[*] You can upload screenshots using the screenshot uploader tool. By default this button is bound to "F12", and can be edited within the Steam settings. 
[*] Open the Steam client and click on "View" and then "Screenshots" at the top to access the screenshot uploader.
[/list]
If you need more assistance with how to upload a screenshot to Steam Community, please check here https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=181142704 

[h3]Rewards:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 1 winner will receive 3 Zombie Within keys 
[/list]

notes.title: Zombie 1.0, West Hunt DLC, New Game Mode, and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/7013d5ee19abef82f2f4f729116ebe136a7a93ae.jpg[/img]

[h1]Zombie Within is officially 1.0![/h1]

Thank you to everyone who joined us on this journey. Now for some updates.

[h2]WEST HUNT DLC[/h2]
Who doesn’t love Cowboys vs. Zombies? To combine our two games the developers have created some epic crossover from their wildly successful Western social deduction game West Hunt and Zombie Within!
[list]
[*] [b]Engineer skins: Cowgirl, Camila and Tallulah.[/b]
[*][b] Hunter skins: Sheriff, Cowboy and Crazy Horse.[/b]
[*] [b]Whistles: Cowboy, Howdy, Hand whistle and War call.[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Find more information here! [/h3]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078050/West_Hunt_Pack/ 

[h2]NEW GAME MODE: Gate Mode[/h2]
In this mode Defenders now have to fight off mini zombies whenever a Zombie Imposter breaks a generator. These bite-sized enemies will actively chase the nearby Defender, but to give them a leg up, Defenders will have various powers ups scattered throughout the map. They can also find power ups in chests and drops after slaying some mini zombies.

[h2]Thank You[/h2]
We want to thank everyone again for being here. We hope that you enjoy our new game mode and DLC, the journey to 1.0 has been one we will never forget! 

- The Zombie Within Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/e6b0c62f8e8735d99af9fea97534f14ed632d3c2.jpg[/img]
We have been looking into ways to improve our gameplay and came up with this fun addition. Let us know what you would like to see in the future! You can let us know here in the Steam Forums or on [url=https://discord.gg/UWWjrbrKQG]Discord[/url], any feedback is welcome feedback!

Adding new classes for the imposters team. Available classes now are as following:

notes.title: Update Version 0.2.2 - Custom Room Rules
notes.content:
[h1]First Major Update since releasing into Early Access[/h1]

[b]Hello Zombies and Survivors! [/b]

In this update you'll be able to adjust additional rules when playing in a Custom Room. 
Ever wish you had a few more bullets to figure out who the Imposter is, or felt you could cause more chaos as a Zombie with extra time? With these new custom rules, you'll be able to adjust the settings in a Custom Room to tailor the experience to your liking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/e55c5001b44afb37129469fbb0c93a1536a5836d.png[/img]
[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
Added custom game room rules where players are able to:
[list]
[*] Change game duration
[*] Change the number of innocent to be killed by imposter
[*] Change number of generators that can be broken
[*] Change the max number of innocent kills for defender
[*] Disable/Enable the red defender outline (for imposter)
[*] Start game with 0 cooldown for Hunter/Engineer
[*] Change max number of level
[*] Start game with available upgrades
[*] Change Trap Stock capacity (For Hunters)
[*] Change max number of traps that can be simultaneously placed (For Hunters)
[*] Change Trap cooldown (For Hunters)
[*] Change Scan cooldown (For Engineers)
[*] Change Scan duration (For Engineers)
[*] Change Scan accuracy (For Engineers)
[*] Change the duration of zombie form when an imposter transforms 
[*] Change the level of infection to start with when the game start
[*] Change the intensity of infection
[/list]
Reporting system - Players now can report one or more player for the following reasons:
[list]
[*] Cheating/Hacking
[*] Harassment/Abuse
[*] Unsportmanlike conduct
[*] Inappropriate content
[*] Inactivity/Afk
[*] Bug exploitation
[/list]

As we continue down this road of early access, let us know what you would like to see! Whether you post in the Steam Forums or on the Wandering Wizard Discord, we want to hear from you!

- The Zombie Within Community Team

notes.title: 1st Patch Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/6ae5eb26951233fbcd34b1ab3c2397a80ae55353.png[/img]

[h2]Hello Zombies and Survivors[/h2]

Here is our first round of patch notes since releasing into early access! We appreciate all the feedback we have received since launch and want to encourage our growing community to keep it coming! That's what early access is all about, you sharing your thoughts and suggestions with us so we can make the best possible game come 1.0 ~ Speaking of suggestions, feel free to join the Wandering Wizard Discord or post to Steam forums with your feedback. 

We have made these patches and hotfixes incrementally since early access launch, so if you do not see these changes to your game, please check if there is an update queued. 

[b][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][/b]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where a lobby could have 2 Engineers in a 2v1 queue
[*] Fixed an issue where the AI could get caught on a light post in the map
[*] Added an indicator of the number of shots needed in the Engineer tutorial when they shoot the Imposter
[*] Added indicative arrows to the Imposter tutorial
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] The “Manual” button in the main menu no longer permanently glows
[*] The tutorial now informs the player of the first role they are learning about
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in a loop while attempting to join the Discord
[*] Fixed an issue where “Custom Mode” would overrun the textbox in German, Italian, Spanish, and Portuguese
[*] New VFX now appears on the minimap when a trap explodes, a scan discovers an imposter, or when an imposter kills an innocent
[*] The in-game Shop now has prices listed for each item
[*] Players should no longer get stuck in a loop if they press H and then J and refuse to join the Discord
[/list]
[h3]Functionality[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game now correctly enters “Full Screen’ when selecting “Revert to default settings”
[*] Fixed issues where “Play” button would not work sometimes
[*] Fixed issues where skins would not equip
[*]Fixed an issue where some Steam achievements were not working
[*]Fixed an issue where an Imposter could win if an innocent died after the Imposter was killed
[/list]
[h3]Text[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed text overlapping the tutorial video occurring under the “Saving Innocents” section of the manual in French, German & Portuguese.
[*] Fixed “Manual” text overlapping the “Settings” text when game language is set to Japanese
[*] Fixed “Tutorial” and “Custom Mode” buttons having their text go outside the box when highlighted in Japanese
[*] Made several grammar and punctuation edits to text in the Manual
[*] Added parentheses to “Break” and “Fix” prompts for clarity
[*] Fixed tutorial text not displaying properly in Turkish
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Generator breaking and fixed sounds can no longer be heard when audio sliders are set to 0
[*] Ambient radio broadcast audio can no longer be heard when all audio is set to 0
[*] Fixed issues with zombie SFX not playing when transforming
[/list]

We’re excited to share this game with everyone! Remember to join the Wandering Wizard Discord server to chat about the game, provide feedback, find people to play with, and more!

- The Zombie Within Community Team

notes.title: Zombie Within is Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/f77d5f87d5fd72b10355521212889071f9b594f5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Zombie Within Available Now[/h1]

Zombie Within is Wandering Wizard and New Gen Studios latest collaboration, which is now officially released in early access! We are so excited to share this Zombie Apocalypse themed Social Deduction Game with you.

Zombie Within is set in a post-apocalyptic camp where [b]Defenders[/b] are tasked with saving humanity by stopping the spread of a zombie virus killing innocent people. But among the defenders, undercover [b]Zombie Imposters[/b] are determined to spread a devastating virus, aiming to eradicate humanity. Play with up to 6 friends or play single player and test your mettle against the game itself!

[h2]Play as a Defender[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/948acbc0c30bc656378bf5fd1be5bcbd43bb26f0.png[/img]

[h2]Play as a Zombie[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/bf16216990ae24ee033223aa8fce474c6abf02ae.png[/img]

[h2]KEY FEATURES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Asymmetrical Social Deduction:[/b] Play as either a Zombie Imposter, blending in to kill as many civilians as possible in the camp, or a Defender, attempting to figure out who amongst the civilians is secretly a zombie.
[*] [b]Cause Mayhem as the Zombie Imposter:[/b]As a Zombie Imposter, pretend you are one of the many civilians of the camp and break as many generators as possible to spread the infection. Once enough infection has spread, an Imposter can transform into a monstrous zombie form, which allows them to attack civilians directly.
[*] [b]Protect the camp as a Defender:[/b] Defenders can take on the roles of Hunters or Engineers. Hunters take down zombie imposters easily and can lay down traps to expose them. Meanwhile, Engineers have tools that allow them to quickly find broken generators, and reveal the imposter amongst the civilians.
[*] [b]Randomly Generated Maps:[/b] Play on either the default map, or test your skills in a randomly generated camp map, with different layouts and generator spawns.
[/list]

[h2]Leaderboard Event: Undead Rush[/h2]
Be sure to also check out our Leaderboard event as well! We wanted to kick off our release with a very special leaderboard event for you! We’re welcoming this new community with open arms, and a scanner at the ready. 

The Top 3 Leaderboard winners will win [b]3 Zombie Within keys[/b] for them and their friends. Be sure to read the official announcement below for more information! https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1894460/view/4166462894410243823

[h2]Join the Discord[/h2]
Join the Wandering Wizard Discord to find games, chat about gameplay, and share your feedback with the devs! [url=https://discord.gg/weYSMTV6DN]Join Here.[/url]

[h2]Stream[/h2]
On top of getting in on the action yourself you can always check out Twitch and YouTube for gameplay! [b]PENTA[/b] will be hopping on with his friends (Kyle, TheChief1114, Moosebrother, s0upes, and CurvyLlama) around 3pm PST today to feature the game, find his Twitch here: https://www.twitch.tv/penta


[h2]Sale[/h2]
Zombie Within will be discounted at [b]20% for an entire week![/b] Swipe it now and save!


There's been a lot of anticipation up until this point and we’re so excited that the day of release is finally here! And we can’t wait to see all of the fun gameplay that’s going to come out as our community grows!

Stay Sharp, Stay Sus, and above all… Play On

- The Wandering Wizard and New Gen Team
